queries.sql: SELECT `do_registration`.`do_no`, `despatch`.`vehicle_no`, `do_registration`.`do_registration_id`, `driver_assignment`.`driver`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses1`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses2`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses3`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses4`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses5`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses6`, DATE(despatch.des_date) as despatch_date, `doprice_change`.`trip1` as `doprice_trip1`, `doprice_change`.`trip2` as `doprice_trip2`, `doprice_change`.`trip3` as `doprice_trip3`, `doprice_change`.`trip4` as `doprice_trip4`, `doprice_change`.`trip5` as `doprice_trip5`, `doprice_change`.`trip6` as `doprice_trip6`, SUM(despatch.quantity) as total_weight, COUNT(despatch.despatch_id) as total_number_of_trip FROM `despatch` LEFT JOIN `do_registration` ON `do_registration`.`do_registration_id` = `despatch`.`do_no` LEFT JOIN `doprice_change` ON `do_registration`.`do_registration_id` = `doprice_change`.`dono` AND `despatch`.`des_date` >= `doprice_change`.`from_date` LEFT JOIN `driver_assignment` ON `driver_assignment`.`vehicle_no` = `despatch`.`vehicle_no` WHERE `despatch`.`vehicle_no` = '61' AND YEAR(despatch.des_date) = '2026' AND MONTH(despatch.des_date) = '1' AND `driver_assignment`.`driver` = '1298' AND despatch.des_date >= driver_assignment.from_date AND despatch.des_date <= driver_assignment.to_date GROUP BY DATE(despatch.des_date), `driver_assignment`.`driver`

SELECT `despatch`.*, `vehicle`.`vehicle_no` AS `reg_no`, `route`.`to_city` AS `trip_location`, `route`.`from_city` AS `from_city`, `route`.`location_shortname` AS `route_name`, `do_registration`.`diesel_type` AS `diesel_required`, `do_registration`.`do_no` AS `do_reg_no` FROM `despatch` LEFT JOIN `vehicle` ON `vehicle`.`id` = `despatch`.`vehicle_no` LEFT JOIN `do_registration` ON `do_registration`.`do_registration_id` = `despatch`.`do_no` LEFT JOIN `route` ON `route`.`id` = `do_registration`.`route_id` LEFT JOIN `driver_assignment` ON `driver_assignment`.`vehicle_no` = `despatch`.`vehicle_no` WHERE `driver_assignment`.`driver` = '1298' AND `despatch`.`des_date` >= '2026-01-01' AND `despatch`.`des_date` <= '2026-01-31' AND despatch.des_date >= driver_assignment.from_date AND (despatch.des_date <= driver_assignment.to_date OR driver_assignment.to_date IS NULL OR driver_assignment.to_date = "0000-00-00" OR driver_assignment.to_date = "") GROUP BY `despatch`.`despatch_id` ORDER BY `despatch`.`des_date` ASC

SELECT `diselentry`.*, `vendor`.`name` as `vendor_name`, `diselentry`.`vehicle_id` as `veh_id` FROM `diselentry` LEFT JOIN `vendor` ON `vendor`.`id` = `diselentry`.`vendor_id` LEFT JOIN `driver_assignment` ON `driver_assignment`.`vehicle_no` = `diselentry`.`vehicle_id` WHERE `driver_assignment`.`driver` = '1298' AND `diselentry`.`diesel_date` >= '2026-01-01' AND `diselentry`.`diesel_date` <= '2026-01-31' AND diselentry.diesel_date >= driver_assignment.from_date AND (diselentry.diesel_date <= driver_assignment.to_date OR driver_assignment.to_date IS NULL OR driver_assignment.to_date = "0000-00-00" OR driver_assignment.to_date = "") AND `diselentry`.`deleted_by` IS NULL GROUP BY `diselentry`.`diselentry_id` ORDER BY `diselentry`.`diesel_date` ASC
